# Enrico Mautone

> Technology leader and entrepreneur based in Livorno (Tuscany, Italy) with 20 years
> in software. Since September 2026 he is CTO & Head of AI at Stories srl, an AI
> startup building a conversational companion for older adults. His blog is about
> what really happens when you try to build an AI product: the choices, the mistakes,
> and the hard parts no demo shows. Blog tagline: "Costruire prodotti AI — dal
> cantiere" (English: "Building AI products — from the trenches"). He is positioning himself
> as a technical co-founder / CTO-level partner for early-stage AI ventures.

## Who he is

- CTO & Head of AI, Stories srl, Pisa (September 2026 – present). Stories is an AI
  companion that brings meaningful conversations, emotional support and family
  moments into the daily routine of older adults (https://stories-app.it). Selected
  among the top 5 finalists of the Startup Geeks Startup Showcase 2026. He owns the
  technology stack and builds the product hands-on: LLM-based conversational
  agents, long-term memory, Python/FastAPI backend on PostgreSQL, Google Cloud
  Platform, privacy by design (GDPR, EU AI Act).
- Service Manager, REMIRA Italia (September 2023 – August 2026): IT Service Manager
  for Gucci on a consulting engagement, bridging business stakeholders and technical
  teams up to client executive level; promoted a Teal / self-management approach.
  Built an internal AI pilot for document recognition (Azure AI Document
  Intelligence + GPT-4).
- Business Analyst, iambOO srl (September 2016 – August 2023): consultant at Kyklos
  (now Remira Italia) for international luxury fashion brands.
- CEO, CTO and co-founder of 4E Studios Srl (October 2011 – August 2016): technology
  studio building MVPs and feasibility studies for startups in food, medical and
  entertainment (video games, VR, AR).
- Earlier: freelance Oracle PL/SQL and JEE developer for logistics (2009–2011), lead
  programmer on a Java EE web application for a United Nations military base in
  Morocco (2008), web/DB programmer (2005–2006).
- Degree in Computer Science, University of Pisa. Certified Scrum Master (CSM).
  Certified Obeya Builder and Obeya Host.
- Languages: Italian (native), English (professional, B2).
- Skills: LLMs and AI agents, conversational AI (LangChain, LangSmith, Hugging Face),
  Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django), PostgreSQL, Google Cloud Platform, software
  architecture, technical leadership, MVP development, Scrum and agile methods.

## What the blog covers

- **Cantiere** (the trenches): how an AI product is built and what breaks.
- **Il metro** (the yardstick): evaluating AI systems when there is no single correct
  output — golden sets, guardrails, thresholds.
- **Il timone** (at the helm): costs, privacy, regulation and the decisions that
  cannot be delegated to AI.

Posts are written in Italian. He writes from the point of view of someone coming to
agentic AI from traditional software engineering, learning on a real product.
